scope: Independent read-only numerical analysis of recorded light ledgers; no game, browser, image inspection or runtime tests performed. Only this derived analysis JSON was written.

method.active_spot: effective_visible and intensity>0 and maximum RGB component>0
method.association: All raw slot positions within 0.05 m, then normalised maximum-component RGB hue difference <=0.02
method.positive_fake_with_matching_spot: Associated fake strength_w>0 and RGB>0 and fake_set_scale>0 with active spot
method.skipped_only: Associated skipped slot without any associated unskipped source
method.far_player: Active spot over 45 horizontal metres from raw player; driving observations are kept separately from actual diner-foot observations
method.wrong_diner_source: Only actual area=diner, driving=false, capture_phase=ultra_onfoot_diagnostic: no associated unskipped diner source
method.trace: Immediate raw step0 retained; steps1..15 are read as recorded at index/30 seconds; no settling or filtering before step0
method.private_ultra_want: Not observed. Source association is geometric/hue evidence; actual spotlight intensity and raw fake strengths are retained.

source_interpretation.pool_origin: Current main.ts:852-853 sends player.pos to Ultra, including driving frames. DriveController changes cab camera/driver pose without synchronizing foot player.pos.
source_interpretation.pool_selection: Ultra.ts chooses three eligible unskipped sources within 40 m every 0.25 simulated seconds; phase of timer can delay first foot selection several trace frames.
source_interpretation.fake_shader: kit.ts ignores raw strength_w<=0; copied negative aliases remain off.
source_interpretation.neon_alias: World.shareLights runs after Ultra; Diner.neon multiplies strength by 2 and RGB by 0.3 for road/oldroad copies. Skipped aliases do not imply skipped-only source if an unskipped diner source is associated.
source_interpretation.image_limit: Red source RGB or positive spot intensity alone is not evidence of a red truck hood, adequate sign/cab/hood coverage, or visually correct ground glow.
